contract: Use request paths only for request-supported capabilities. For editor-only capabilities, disclose the exact follow-up action; never silently claim the request created it.

capabilities.verification: validate_request + manifest semantic parity
static rows and runtime aggregates agree
both chart type and channel bindings exist
compiled values match runtime values

capabilities.editorAction: 表格卡字段库：把「指标名称」拖到行区或列区
capabilities.fallback: request creates a multi-measure table with measures as separate columns; explicitly disclose that pivot remains manual

capabilities.editorAction: 在表格卡清空行区，保留列区维度
capabilities.fallback: request creates the nearest row-dimension × column-dimension crosstab; explicitly disclose the manual row removal

capabilities.editorAction: 在对应页签插入筛选器卡，将作用范围设为「页签」
capabilities.fallback: request.filters is report-wide; explicitly disclose that tab scope requires the editor

capabilities.editorAction: 拖动表格列缘设置列宽，双击恢复自适应
capabilities.fallback: request leaves automatic width; explicitly disclose geometry is editor-only

capabilities.editorAction: 在表格卡设置中勾选聚合/明细视图并选择明细列
capabilities.fallback: request creates separate aggregate and detail cards; explicitly disclose same-card switching is manual

capabilities.editorAction: 进入汇报模式，逐页拖拽或调整标题带
capabilities.fallback: request seeds the default 16:9 page layout; explicitly disclose manual fine-tuning

capabilities.verification: section chart references resolve and every chart has one section
parent-child closure and drill filters remain in the same dataset
date_parse sort/bucket and server daterange agree
format rules are bounded and totals policy is explicit

capabilities.resultPath: chart editor table modes + drill metadata
capabilities.verification: detail fields are declared and sensitive fields remain blocked

capabilities.editorAction: 打开数据源配置，选择替换数据或追加新行，并在任务条确认终态
capabilities.fallback: request can declare source files for a rebuild; existing server data is not mutated without an approved data-update job

capabilities.verification: chartId + contextKey + datasetRevision are server-validated and card history is isolated
dataset, fields, filters, pivot, bucket and aggregation conflicts are returned as evidence
server aggregation and date_parse time keys produce bounded evidence with assumptions
no direct mutation; proposal diff, approval, snapshot, hash check and rollback are required
suggestions are linked to observed aggregate evidence, bounded to read-only typed tools, and explicitly non-causal
explicit fiscalStartMonth is validated; SQL Agent labels and gap analysis remain date_parse-backed; chart renderer does not silently infer a calendar

authored/manifest aliases are accepted; inferred aliases remain requiresConfirmation until explicit confirmation, which emits an editor-approved proposal; sensitive/conflicting aliases fail closed; applied confirmations feed a local cross-report learning directory (state-home alias-learning.sqlite3) that only ever returns read-only source=learned suggestions — confidence capped at 0.9, requiresConfirmation always true, sensitive columns never learned (LRM_ALIAS_LEARNING=0 disables)
bounded read-only graph is tenant-scoped; cross-dataset same-name fields are candidates only and never inferred joins
bounded heuristic is explainable and explicitly non-calibrated/non-probabilistic; malformed provenance fails closed
server-only bounded provider /models discovery returns legal model IDs without exposing API keys or silently aliasing unknown models; final Chat Completions test remains authoritative
scripts/derived_model is the single validator (重名/未知列/DAG 循环/窗口 timeField/filtered 谓词白名单 col-vs-column)；敏感列闭包 fail-closed；应用走 metadataOnly ProposalTransaction（snapshot/hash/rollback），回滚后 manifest 还原

columns are caller-declared (never guessed); balance reconciles with tiered tolerance (relative 1e-6 + absolute 0.5, optional tolerance/absTolerance args, applied pair reported as toleranceUsed) and marks the first period unverifiable instead of inventing an opening stock; weeks-of-supply states its 52/12 week conversion in evidence.assumptions; stockout_scan supports granularity=sum (default, in-group netting) and granularity=row (per-row verdict with row counts/ratio and bounded hit samples ≤50), bounded top-N and over-limit scans fail closed; evidence carries provenance with causalClaim=false and PSI CSV truth reconciliation is 0-error
